item.title: Advancing Research on Health and Well-being in Entrepreneurship through Intervention Research: Bridging Relevance and Impact
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on understanding and improving health and well-being outcomes for entrepreneurs through intervention-based research approaches. The collection seeks to bridge the gap between academic research and practical impact by exploring how targeted interventions can address health challenges specific to entrepreneurial contexts.

Appel publié par Journal of Business Venturing Insights. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
